description: Open the dataset '~/Documents/Jamovi/InsectSprays.csv'. Filter the data to include ONLY the rows where 'spray' is 'F' or 'C'. Run an Independent Samples T-Test with 'count' as the Dependent Variable and 'spray' as the Grouping Variable. Enable the 'Homogeneity test' (Levene's) to check assumptions. Because the variances are unequal, you MUST report the Welch's t-test results, NOT the Student's t-test. Save the project as '~/Documents/Jamovi/Spray_Comparison.omv'. Create a text file '~/Documents/Jamovi/robust_results.txt' with the following labeled values on separate lines: Levene_p, Statistic_Choice (write 'Welch'), t_statistic, df, p_value, Mean_Difference.
